description: The Boreal Wetland Inventory of Ducks Unlimited Canada consists of Enhanced Wetland Classification (EWC) maps of the western Canadian boreal region, produced by DUC's GIS and remote sensing services with partners. The products are detailed wetland classification raster datasets at 10 or 30 metre resolution, with up to 19 boreal wetland classes depending on the region, aligned with the Canadian Wetland Classification System. The page is addressed to organisations that operate or plan to operate in wetland-rich parts of the western boreal and need wetland data for land-use decisions and conservation. Many EWC inventories are complete; information is requested through an enquiry form, and data may be provided under varying data use or licensing agreements. Caveats: the data is not openly downloadable, and coverage is limited to the areas mapped so far. Coverage is the western Canadian boreal region. It supports hazard exposure and environmental analysis for linear infrastructure, such as routing roads, pipelines and power lines around wetlands, and nature-based flood storage; related records are the US National Wetlands Inventory and the Global Lakes and Wetlands Database.
